title: Cozee Sleeve
alternative_to: A separate cup sleeve plus a paper napkin
Double-cupping a hot drink for heat protection
featured_hook: A cup sleeve that unfolds into a napkin
problem_solved: Hot and iced drinks need a sleeve, and people still reach for a napkin
Double-walled cups and extra napkins add single-use waste
why_we_like_it: One recycled kraft sleeve for hot and iced drinks, and it unfolds into a napkin
The published case is 750 sleeves for $40 and includes a countertop dispenser
The maker says it is assembled in America
considerations: The $40 price on cozeesleeve.com is the 750-count case, not a single sleeve
Greenroad does not sell this product or take payment for it
Order and custom printing stay on the maker's site
evidence: cozeesleeve.com lists the 100% recycled kraft sleeve as a 750-count case for $40, including a countertop dispenser
The same page describes 24 overlapping layers for heat and condensation, and says the sleeves are assembled in America

signals_from_web.signal: Cup sleeve that unfolds into a napkin. 750-count recycled kraft case, $40, dispenser included.

seo_description: A recycled kraft cup sleeve that unfolds into a napkin. Visit Cozee Sleeve for the 750-count case.
